title: Keep every contribution when consolidating shopping rows
description: The pantry.py helpers serve one small batch-preparation planner. A row consolidation refactor now loses contributions for repeated ingredients. Repair aggregate_items(rows). The supported input is a list of at most 100 rows, each exactly a mapping with item (any Unicode string, including empty) and units (a whole-number JSON value from 0 through 1000000). Item equality is exact string equality, including case and Unicode composition. Whole-number JSON values mean finite integral numbers after JSON transport, excluding booleans; no Python int-versus-float distinction is promised. None/null, nonintegral numbers, other shapes, and inputs outside the stated bounds are outside this retained contract.

requirements.text: Return one {"item": name, "units": total} row for each distinct exact input item, summing units across all occurrences. Keep a row even when its total is zero. An empty input returns [].
The output rows appear in the order of each item's first occurrence in the input, regardless of alphabetic order or later occurrences.
Leave the input list and every input row mapping unchanged in content, including on calls that consolidate repeated items.

provenance: Original independent AI-authored batch-preparation library; author job repo05, repository owned-v2-r05; CC0-1.0. No upstream code or data.
